notes.title: Version 1.0.7 UPDATE
notes.content:
[h2]Ghost updates[/h2]
[list]
・Fixed the problem that World Ghost was not properly downloaded.
・Added a button to upload your own ghost to the main menu.
・Implemented a UI to show the local and world ghost possession status to the main menu.
・Implement an icon to show the upload status of each user's ghost to the ranking entry
　-No icon: not yet uploaded
　-White icon: uploaded and undownloaded
　-Green Icon: Downloaded
　-Yellow icon: your ghost.
・Improved the process of uploading ghosts.
・Fixed a bug that prevented the ghost from uploading properly when using the same PC and different Steam accounts.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 UPDATE
notes.content:
[h2]Can now view the ranking ver. 2[/h2]
Added a toggle switch to the main menu to switch between versions of the rankings.
[h2]Fixed around ranking UI[/h2]
[list]
・Fixed the bug that when displaying OWN category in the world ranking, it was not possible to get the ranking entry correctly if it was near the end of the ranking.
・Fixed a bug lurking in the rankings.
[/list]
[h2]Fixed around Ghost mode button[/h2]
[list]
・Fixed a click detection of ghost mode button overlapped with world ghost mode button.
・Fixed a bug where processing was not completed in the agreement check.
・Added a cancel button to the checkbox for agreement on terms of use.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 UPDATE
notes.content:
[h2]Ghost (global) update[/h2]
[list]

[/list]
[h2]More updates[/h2]

・Debug mode is now invisible to  public.
[/list]

notes.title: Hot Fix
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the synchronization process with Steam Workshop would not end when World Ghost Mode was enabled.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 UPDATE
notes.content:
[h2]Preparing to share ghost data with the world[/h2]
[h3]Implemented[/h3]
[list]
・Uploading Ghost data (attached to a ranking entry when the record is updated)
・Obtaining ghost data from ranking entries
[/list]

[h3]WIP[/h3]
[list]
・Replaying acquired Ghost data
[/list]

[h2]Prepare to migrate to new rankings[/h2]
[h3]Issue[/h3]
The Steam rankings can only be updated with a single number, and the clear time is too important.
[h3]Solution[/h3]
The overall score is calculated from the status of the stage clearing, including the clear time, and used as the key to ranking.
[h3]Migration period[/h3]
The old and new rankings will be compiled simultaneously, and the old rankings will be displayed until enough data is collected for the new rankings.
In about two weeks to one month, we will switch to the new-style rankings.

[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
・Fix potential bugs
[/list]
